desc:
Build a real house, piece by piece, with your own hands!

BRICKS: spread the mortar, lay the brick, cut it with a saw or a pencil line.
LOGS: stack a log cabin. The axe chops the notches, the plane cuts the groove, the mallet seats every log.
PLANKS: saw them to length, lay floors, nail boards to your walls.
STEEL: hold it with a magnet, then weld the seam with a torch. Weld it badly and it falls!
Cut doors and windows into your walls, then raise the roof.
Paint with a roller, make furniture at the workbench, plant your garden.

Everything stands or falls by real rules: take out the wrong log and watch the wall come down.

Invite friends to build with you, or visit their houses.
Your house is saved. Come back any time and keep building your dream home!
